test_title: PYST 1: SSC CHSL 2024 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 01 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: Which of the following is a correct statement?

options.text: Equal chords are equidistant from the centre of the circle but not always subtend equal angle at centre of the circle
If two circles touch each other, the point of contact lies on the line joining the two centres.
Angles subtended by the arc in the same segment of the circle are in ratio of 2 : 1.
The sum of the angles of a cyclic quadrilateral is always 180º.

solution:
**Calculation:**

Option 1: Equal chords are equidistant from the centre of the circle but not always subtend equal angle at centre of the circle.

This statement is incorrect as equal chords subtend equal angles at the centre of the circle.

Option 2: If two circles touch each other, the point of contact lies on the line joining the two centres.
